name: United States v. Virginia
summary: The Supreme Court struck down the Virginia Military Institute's male-only admissions policy, holding that sex-based government action must be supported by an exceedingly persuasive justification.
significance: Petitioners cite it for the principle that government-sponsored sex-based exclusions must be justified by an exceedingly persuasive justification, relevant to whether blanket bans on transgender athletes can withstand constitutional and statutory scrutiny.
